body.intent: Autonomy per workflow: a workflow file declares its autonomy per stage (plan, accept, ship, signoff as auto or owner), with autonomous = true|false as shorthand, or omits it to follow rhiza.autonomy.*; the declaration overrides rhiza.autonomy.* for that workflow's runs (today autonomyStage in internal/api/request.go:294 and daemon.go:834-843 read only the settings), and rhiza health and the run record show where a run's autonomy came from. The built-in milestone planning workflow declares owner, as a default a repo can change (supersedes failed request 01M6MY89 that hard-codes milestone planning needing a human). Acceptance: a bugfix workflow declaring autonomous = true takes a bug request from plan through ship with no owner step while rhiza.autonomy.plan stays owner. Follows decision workflows-are-the-rules (PR #353): every rule is workflow policy the owner defines, Rhiza ships defaults and enforces only references between nodes.
